text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару, the Umamusume
blessed
with divine luck, performs well
in her debut.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Intending to let the fates decide her
next goal,
she asks me to draw a fortune
slip.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Following the will of the fortune slip, it
seems our
next race is the Yayoi Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Following the will of the fortune slip, it
seems our
next race is the Spring Stakes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Following the will of the fortune slip, it
seems our
next race is the Mainichi Hai.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The first hurdle of spring is here!

Matikanefukukitaru's battle has begun!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
